compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing bash tests in `tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh` covering the new arbiter-rulings.json read path in pre-commit-review-gate.sh.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD8: pre-commit hook reads arbiter-rulings.json + blocks on BLOCK ruling for current HEAD commit_sha.

## Specific failing test cases (bash test functions)

1. `test_arbiter_block_for_current_sha_blocks_commit` — pre-seed `<artifacts_dir>/arbiter-rulings.json` (valid JSON) with `{"schema_version":"1.0.0","commit_sha":"<HEAD>","rulings":[{"ruling":"BLOCK","rationale":"critical bug"}],"summary":{"block_count":1}}`. Also pre-seed valid review-status. Run gate; assert exit 1 AND stderr contains "critical bug".
2. `test_arbiter_drop_only_does_not_block` — sidecar has only DROP/DEFER (block_count:0); assert exit 0.
3. `test_arbiter_block_for_different_sha_ignored` — sidecar commit_sha = "old-sha"; BLOCK ruling; assert exit 0 (prior-commit sidecar ignored).
4. `test_no_arbiter_sidecar_preserves_existing_behavior` — no sidecar; review-status valid; assert exit 0.
5. `test_corrupt_arbiter_sidecar_fails_closed_with_warning` — write malformed JSON; assert exit 1 (fail-closed) + stderr WARNING about parse failure.
6. `test_self_heal_path_still_checks_arbiter_block` — REGRESSION GUARD: stage a .py file with formatting-only drift (triggers `_is_formatting_only_drift` self-heal path). Pre-seed arbiter-rulings.json with BLOCK for current HEAD. Without the fix, self-heal `exit 0` at line ~470 would bypass arbiter check. With the fix, gate must still exit 1 because arbiter ruling is present. Assert exit 1 + stderr contains the BLOCK rationale.

## All sidecar JSON fixtures MUST be valid JSON
(double-quoted keys, no Python-style single quotes).

## Test framework
Project's bash test pattern. Each test sets `WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR=$(mktemp -d)`, writes fixtures, invokes `bash plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh`, asserts exit + stderr.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 6 test functions defined (one per scenario above)
  Verify: grep -cE '^test_' tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh   # expect ≥ 6
- [ ] Test file is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh
- [ ] All 6 tests fail (gate has no arbiter-rulings.json read yet, and self-heal still bypasses)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh 2>&1 | grep -cE '(FAIL|✗)'   # expect ≥ 6
- [ ] Test is registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep 'test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh' .test-index
- [ ] shellcheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh (new, ~260 lines)
- .test-index (append registration)
